# gxkit

> Agent-native review loops for creative artifacts. Write the artifact as code, `inspect` it, get problems with stable codes and exit codes, fix them, and ship — with a storyboard image as evidence.

gxkit is a shared engine (`gxcore`) plus the domain tools built on it. Each tool
owns one domain; the review loop is written once.

## Tools

- **chartgx** — matplotlib charts: truncated bar baselines, clipped or
  overlapping text, missing titles/labels/units, dual axes, unreadable pies,
  constant or clipped data. `packages/chartgx`
- **levelgx** — game levels: no spawn/goal, unreachable goal, soft-lock from a
  one-way tile, stranded items, hazards that cut the only route.
  `packages/levelgx`
- **flowgx** — state machines / flow charts: unreachable states, dead ends,
  states that can never finish, non-deterministic events.
  `packages/flowgx`
- **authzgx** — permission models / RBAC: privilege-escalation paths, cyclic
  inheritance, dangling references, dead config. `packages/authzgx`
- planned: `shadergx` (shader/GPU output), `docgx` (document/slide layout).

`gxcore` also shares the analysis the tools need: `graph` (reachability, traps,
shortest path, cycles), `layout` (text small/clipped/overlapping), `loading`,
and `diagram` (a deterministic node-link renderer).

## The contract every tool shares

```sh
<tool> inspect artifact.py     # problems + storyboard, exit 1 on any error
<tool> inspect artifact.py --json
<tool> render  artifact.py -o out.png
```

- **Exit code 1** when any `error`-severity problem is found. `warn` and `info`
  never fail the build.
- **A storyboard image** with each located problem boxed and numbered.
- **Stable codes** (`truncated-baseline`, `soft-lock`, …) an agent branches on,
  never on prose.

## Install a tool

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/chartgx" chartgx inspect chart.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/levelgx" levelgx inspect level.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/flowgx" flowgx inspect machine.py
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/authzgx" authzgx inspect auth.py
```

Needs Python 3.10+; `chartgx` also needs matplotlib and numpy.

## Develop

```sh
uv sync --all-packages
uv run pytest
uv run chartgx inspect packages/chartgx/examples/bad_chart.py      # exit 1
uv run levelgx inspect packages/levelgx/examples/softlock_level.py # exit 1
uv run flowgx  inspect packages/flowgx/examples/broken_machine.py  # exit 1
```

See [`docs/PLAN.md`](docs/PLAN.md) for goals and the roadmap, and
[`docs/agent-native-landscape.md`](docs/agent-native-landscape.md) for which
domains are still empty.
